population.rule: settled series date > 2026-07-28, frame recipe verbatim

beta_freeze_fixture.rule: ladder value used VERBATIM regardless; gap > 0.001 would be logged loudly

checkpoints.alpha_spend: one-sided alpha per look {0.001, 0.005, 0.025}, union bound 0.031 <= 0.05 per arm; conservative under positive correlation of sequential looks; O'Brien-Fleming-shaped (early promotion demands near-certainty because MDE(100)=6.18m)
checkpoints.kill_rule: at any checkpoint, an arm whose block_event 95% CI has ci_hi < 0 is KILLED: never promotable in v9; it continues to be scored and reported through n=400 for the record
checkpoints.reads_remaining: these 3 checkpoint reads are the only permitted reads of post-07/28 performance; each appends to stats/v9_looks.json prospective_reads

no_peeking: no aggregate over post-cutoff rows exists outside checkpoint_reads; per-series predictions above are stored without aggregation (protocol integrity clause)

termination.no_promotion_by_400: v9 ends in NO SHIP; any revival requires a new preregistered cycle on NEW prospective data (never a re-test on the same 400)
termination.early_promotion: a promotion at n in {100,200} does not end scoring; the remaining checkpoints are still evaluated and reported (the promoted arm can still be killed by the kill rule at a later checkpoint, which retracts the promotion)
